question: Should OpenClaw accept `{ owner }` records as a persisted read-side contract for `plugins.slots.memory` and `plugins.slots.contextEngine` now, and use this branch as that implementation after repair?
rationale: The PR widens a config/API surface with compatibility, auth-provider, and availability impact, while the canonical RFC was stale-closed without an explicit maintainer acceptance comment.

options.title: Repair and sponsor owner records
options.body: Accept the read-side object-form slot contract, require the current P1/P2 repairs, and ask for exact-head real behavior proof before merge.

options.title: Pause behind product direction
options.body: Keep the PR open but blocked until a maintainer reopens or replaces the stale RFC with an accepted slot ownership design.

options.title: Decline the core contract now
options.body: Close or ask for a fresh proposal if maintainers want to keep plugin slots string-only until the broader memory slot architecture is settled.

recommendation.title: Repair and sponsor owner records
recommendation.body: Accept the read-side object-form slot contract, require the current P1/P2 repairs, and ask for exact-head real behavior proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This account has recent plugin manifest and activation-planning history closest to the slot contract decision and was mentioned in the PR timeline for review context.
